primitives.name: Oracle Cloud Turnkey Infrastructure
primitives.verbatim_quote: SEO flywheel (#3 — shipped, 2 commits queued to push) ✅ **C1 — `/preview/[sport]/[slug]` pages + sitemap extension shipped.** - `apps/web/app/preview/[sport]/[slug]/page.tsx` — DB-backed matchup preview pages with metadata + JSON-LD structured data.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes stable internet connectivity, proper environment variable security, and adherence to service provider terms of service.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Operational singularity occurs when any environment variable is misconfigured, leading to service degradation or unauthorized access.

layer2.mapping: The infrastructure setup mirrors a distributed ledger transaction validation process, where each node (VPS) independently verifies and logs transactions (API calls) to ensure consensus and prevent double-spending (rate limiting).
layer2.telemetry: Key verification metrics include API request success rate, latency percentiles, and error codes, which help detect network congestion or server overload.
